sources.method: Vendor dataset of prompts, countries, engines, citations, and mentions; inspect the publication for current detail.

sources.method: Vendor observations over a stated keyword set and repeated parses.

sources.method: Independent panel observation; see source for sample and collection window.

sources.method: Small manually audited observational dataset; read the article for sample and concentration details.
